channel.title: Qualys incidents — Vendor Status Watch

item.title: US Platform 1, US Platform 2, US Platform 3, EU Platform 2: Whitelabel Error Page appearing while accessing the Activity Logs in Admin Module [IM-12852] [investigating]
item.description:
Qualys Cloud Platform Operations is currently investigating an issue impacting users who are unable to access the "Activity Logs" section under the Admin module. Affected users may encounter a "Whitelabel Error Page" when attempting to view the Activity Logs.
Further updates will be shared as they become available.
The ticket reference for this incident is IM-12852.

item.title: EU03, AU01 and CA01 Platforms: False-Positive Vulnerability Findings with Cloud Agent for Windows 6.5 / 6.6 (IM-12827) [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. The affected version was rolled out only to the EU03, AU01, and CA01 platforms, and the published agent version on these platforms has already been reverted to 6.4 to prevent further agents from auto-upgrading. A fix has already been identified and will be delivered in Cloud Agent for Windows 6.7.2, starting rollout on August 24, 2026.
